title: FHIR-RAG: Paired-Data Comparison of Structured FHIR and LLM-Narrative Retrieval for Adherence-Indicator Question Answering
description:
Source code accompanying the preprint Representation Wins on QA, Not on ML: A Paired-Data Comparison of Structured FHIR and LLM-Narrative Retrieval for Adherence-Indicator Question Answering on Long-Acting Specialty Regimens (Jani 2026). For the full combined deposit (preprint PDF + code + synthetic dataset), see DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20292792.

The repository provides three retrieval systems over 200 paired-representation specialty-medication patient records (FHIR R4B bundles and LLM-generated narratives derived from the same bundles): System A (Narrative RAG), System B (Structured Naive FHIR RAG), and System C (Structured Resource-Aware FHIR RAG). Two further arms are included: System N (no-retrieval baseline) and System A-T (deterministic templated-narrative ablation).

The evaluation harness scores 13,800 programmatically-verified adherence-indicator questions across five Patient Support Program (PSP) families (next-dose lookup, dose-history aggregation / MPR, coverage-window reasoning / PDC, missed-dose detection, persistence). No LLM-as-judge is used anywhere in evaluation; all ground-truth values are computed from FHIR resources by pure-Python adherence-metric functions.

The combined Zenodo deposit at DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20292792 (v1.0.0, published 2026-05-18) holds the preprint PDF, this code archive, and the synthetic dataset under one CC-BY-4.0 record umbrella; the code component within that deposit remains Apache-2.0 via the included LICENSE file. Future GitHub releases auto-archive to Zenodo via this .zenodo.json under a new DOI in the same Concept family.
